lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Partner,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: are you busy?
Not at all. I was looking for something to do.
So busy that I need a distraction.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That's a good thing.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: There's an interesting form of travel I've been looking into lately,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: and I was wondering if you'd like to join me.
Sounds intriguing.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'm sure you'll love it.
I know you're a big gearhead, but didn't know you had such a passion for travel.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Well, in this case, they're actually one and the same.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Have you heard of java travel?
Can't say I have.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: You take some hot water, coffee grounds, and sugar,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: then ride your bike off to somewhere far far away.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Once you get to your destination, you make yourself a cup of coffee.
Okay, now I understand.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Doesn't it sound invigorating?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Riding wild and free, the wind on your face,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: having just downed a solid cup of joe.
Sounds magical.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If you've got a spare moment, would you like to try it together?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll bring enough coffee for both of us.
That would be amazing.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll bring a healthy amount of sugar too, about 30 cubes.
Uh...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I can't wait to see what you think of it,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll come pick you up once I'm done preparing everything.
